threads.title: New here? How a search works
threads.body: Read this before you post a tip.
steps: Only share tips ComForce has already verified. Rumors stay in drafts.
Claim a sector on the Search grid, then mark it searching or cleared.
Never post a home address. Rally points are corners, in public.

threads.title: Live search: Darnell, 14. Rally point moved
threads.body: Rally point is now N 27th St and W Wells St. 4 of 8 blocks are searched. Wear something visible and check in with Andre before you start a sector.

threads.title: Verified tip: green jacket, last seen near 27th and Wells
threads.body: A clerk confirmed the jacket about 5:40. If you are on sector B, walk the lit side of Wells and call the search lead before you approach anyone.

threads.title: I can take a sector after 7. Which one is still open?
threads.body: I am in Westown and can walk for about an hour. First search, so I would rather pair with someone.
threads.ai_answer: Sector D is still pending. Pair with Andre at the rally point, N 27th St and W Wells St, before you start. Do not search alone on your first night.

threads.title: New here? How this hub works
threads.body: Three things, then you are ready.
steps: Need food tonight? Check Pantry map for what is open now.
Have extra? Use Share food. Your address is only shared with the person who claims it.
Every post is checked before it goes public, to keep everyone safe.

threads.title: Where can I get baby formula tonight?
threads.body: Store by me is out and I don't get paid till Friday.
threads.ai_answer: 2 pantries with formula are open until 8 PM within a mile. A neighbor can also drop some off, and Keisha was offered a private request.

threads.title: Day-old bread and produce, free after 7 PM
threads.body: About 6 cases. Bring a bag. Posted as a pantry, so it shows on the map until 9.

threads.title: Our block club can host a pantry shelf. Who stocks it?
threads.body: We have a porch with a roof and a neighbor home most days.

threads.title: Please drop diapers at my house
threads.body: I live at 1841 N 23rd St. Size 4 if you have them.
threads.held_reason: It included a home address. We asked the author to take the address out. Share a corner, or let a coordinator make a private request.

threads.title: This hub is private. Read this first
threads.body: Membership is never listed. Posts stay inside the hub.
steps: Do not post your address, workplace, or full name of anyone else.
Quick Exit is on every screen. On a computer, press Esc. Come back with three taps on the blue bar.
For a way out tonight, open Find a way out. Sojourner is 414-933-2722. ComForce is 414-395-0552.

threads.title: Is the 24/7 line staffed tonight?
threads.body: I may need to call from a friend's phone. I do not want to post where I am.
threads.ai_answer: Yes. Sojourner Family Peace Center answers 24/7 at 414-933-2722. ComForce answers at 414-395-0552. You do not need to say where you are to ask for a check-in.

threads.title: Practice Quick Exit once, before you need it
threads.body: Tap the red button or press Esc. The screen becomes a bus schedule. Tap the blue bar three times to come back. Shake-to-exit lives under your initial, for phones.

threads.title: New here? How rides work
threads.body: A ride is a seat, not a home address.
steps: Post a corner and a time on the Ride board. Not a house number.
Aisha confirms the driver before you get in.
If plans change, say so on the thread so the seat can go to someone else.

threads.title: Two seats, Thursday morning, clinic loop
threads.body: Leaving N 27th St and W Wells St at 8:10. Back by noon. Say which clinic and I will confirm with Aisha.

threads.title: Can I get a ride to a clinic this Thursday?
threads.body: I have an appointment at 9. I can be at a main corner. I do not want to put the clinic name if that is too much.
threads.ai_answer: Camila has two seats Thursday, leaving N 27th St and W Wells St at 8:10. Post the corner you can reach. Aisha at the ride desk confirms the driver before you go. The clinic name can stay in a private request.

threads.title: New here? How Cycle Breakers works
threads.body: This hub is for the adults around a young person.
steps: Circles are Thursdays. Ages 13–19 come with a mentor, not from a public post.
Do not post a young person's name, school, or address.
Mentor match is a request. Sam reads every one.

threads.title: Thursday circle: 14 going, still room for two mentors
threads.body: Same room as last week. Doors at 6, start at 6:30. If you can sit with a new young person, say so here.

threads.title: We are on standby. Here is what changes when weather turns
threads.body: Until then, this hub stays quiet on purpose.
steps: Shelter map shows buildings that can open. Hours update when a drop is called.
Welfare checks are assigned. Do not knock on a block you were not given.
Post what you can carry, not where you live.

threads.title: If it freezes tonight, which lobby is actually open?
threads.body: I can give someone a ride to a door, but only if staff are there.
threads.ai_answer: King Library and the church basement on the shelter map can open as warming rooms when ComForce calls it. They are not open just because the thread is. Check News before you drive anyone over.

threads.title: New here? How swaps work
threads.body: Borrow it, bring it back, tell the next parent.
steps: Post the item and a corner on the Swap board. Not a home address.
Childcare posts need a first name and a time. A coordinator glances at them.
If a trade falls through, say so. Someone else is waiting on the size.

threads.title: Size 4 diapers for size 5, this weekend
threads.body: Unopened box. I can meet at a library corner Saturday morning.

threads.title: Anyone able to watch a 4-year-old Thursday afternoon?
threads.body: About two hours, near a park, while I am at an appointment. Happy to swap next week.
threads.ai_answer: Thursday childcare posts go through a parent volunteer. Luis has swapped care before. Reply here with a time and a public corner, and keep last names and addresses off the thread.

threads.title: New here? How the show uses the hubs
threads.body: The episode comes from questions people already asked.
steps: Live tapings are on the map. Doors open 30 minutes early.
Ask a question on this hub if you want it read on air. Say if your name should stay off.
We do not read addresses, workplaces, or anything from Domestic Safety.

threads.title: New episode: what the ride desk learned this month
threads.body: Aisha walks through how a ride is confirmed, and what never goes on the board. Live questions Friday.

replies.body: Church basement pantry has formula until 8. If you want a drop-off instead, I can make that a private request so the address never hits the thread.
I can run a can over after the porch shelf is stocked, if Denise opens the private request.
Private request please. Thank you both.
I can take a case of bread to the porch shelf after 7:30 if that helps.
Start with bread, canned protein, and formula if we have it. I will put your block on the stocking list. Do not post the house number.
I can do the first stocking run Saturday morning. Marcus, tell me the corner, not the door.
Sectors A and B are searching. C is cleared. D is still open if you are new and want a partner.
Come to the rally point and look for the red vest. We will walk D together.
Call Sojourner at 414-933-2722. If you only have a minute, call ComForce at 414-395-0552 and say you need a check-in. You do not have to explain where you are.
Driver confirmed. Two seats. Reply with a corner, and I will match you. No house numbers on this thread.
I can take you if you can be at 27th and Wells by 8:10. Aisha has the clinic list privately.
I can sit as the extra mentor. I will be there at 6.
I can do 1 to 3 if we meet at the library corner. My kid will be with me. Next week I need the same swap.
If you call in, ask about corners and confirmation. Leave the neighbor's trip details out.

items.title: Stay on lit main streets. Do not cut through alleys.
On the MSOE campus, go to Public Safety at 1025 N Broadway.
In the city, go to Sojourner Family Peace Center, 619 W Walnut St.
If you only have a moment, call ComForce.
